name: dive-into-deep-learning
description: Knowledge base compiled from Dive into Deep Learning (d2l.ai; Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola, CC BY-SA 4.0, open source at d2l-ai/d2l-en). 26 chapter files covering the full modern deep-learning stack: linear models, MLPs, CNNs (LeNet to ResNet/DenseNet), RNNs/LSTM/GRU, attention and transformers (incl. ViT and BERT pretraining), optimization (SGD to AdamW with LR schedules), computational performance and multi-GPU training, computer vision, NLP, RL, Gaussian processes, hyperparameter optimization, GANs, and recommender systems — each chapter file adds a 2026 delta on what changed since the book. Original synthesis throughout: it indexes the source and never reproduces its text. Use when studying or teaching D2L, choosing an architecture/optimizer/loss for a task, debugging training runs, or checking whether the book's advice is still current.
